notes.title: Crytivo Plays Look Alive
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39472089/78023b3c8c22fba660dd4643e90dda1e2a7b24b4.png[/img]

Join us as Alex from Crytivo takes on the apocalypse.


[h2]About:[/h2]
It’s time to look alive and get to safety. Drive, scavenge, eat, and crush ragdoll zombies as you try to survive this vast world. Meet survivors and accept quests or make enemies and loot them all.

Look Alive is an open-world survival game set right after the zombie apocalypse started. You are one of the last survivors left in this world full of dead, struggling to stay alive. Despite all the difficulties, you still have hope to find a safe shelter and a cure. Will you succeed in your journey or will you die? It is up to you and how well you scavenge.
